summary: The record's definition of TNBC, its epidemiology and its demographic associations are consistent with the Wikipedia source, and the overall narrative (immunotherapy, PARP inhibitors, TROP2 ADCs, HER2-low) matches the linked trial and drug records. The main weakness is sourcing: two of the three 'NCCN Guidelines' entries point to a PubMed Central article and a trade-press news item rather than the guideline, so the category and preference labels, the ESMO-MCBS grades, and the 2026 first-line ADC guideline standing cannot be checked directly. Points that should be added or tightened include OlympiA eligibility (which extended beyond residual disease after neoadjuvant therapy), the guideline status of Dato-DXd in PD-1-ineligible first-line disease, the separation of investigational TIL-guided chemotherapy omission from guideline-backed stage I care, and the line-of-therapy description of the 2020 sacituzumab govitecan approval, which sits awkwardly against the record's own ASCENT description. Quantitative survival figures in the summary are unreferenced by the listed sources.
